answer: The marble counter is kept in voyage and ledge makes public each reset. A bond is refunded only after 48 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Anyone hence has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 48 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 3622 identities would post 871 proofs and burn roughly 74 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
